notes.title: Early Access Release
notes.notes:
The game now contains everything we envisioned it needs for an Early Access release, and we believe that it is time to take the next step.

We have been involving playtesters since the early prototyping stage. Their feedback has helped us shape the game into what is today. Providing players with the opportunity to engage with us during Early Access feels like a very natural continuation of this approach.

Harry and I are looking forward to welcoming our Early Access players, engaging with them and providing them with regular content updates & bugfixes. We are excited to embark on this journey together and curious to see where it will lead Command Line Pilot.

Hope to see you on 22 July!
Alexander & Harry
